posts.title: How to mess up a networking project ?
posts.body:
Netherrack is being built to give the ability I never had to every amateur in PMMP or Minecraft Bedrock Server Development, build your first network, I'm really tired by entering servers, especially in MENA , finding them just wrapped up Multiworlds and calling them "Networks" , are you really f*cking kidding me ? want to build a network ? build a really one, but it's hard , it's expensive, we are not a 1000 players yet.

well , on the last point you are right, don't optimize for a thousand user, but also don't be able to only handle thirty, for MENA Server Owners, my message for you , as someone who has been into this field for more than six years now, these are not money machines , you are just making our reflection of creating things in the other side of the planet worse. imagine that only two servers in the MENA which is being built according to real standards ? I know the urge of the teenager to open a minecraft server and wanna compete with the league of the big,  yeah thats real, but atleast show some ambition.

So back on our point, why Netherrack, at theory it's planned to handle 200 players, then max it out to 350.
low number I guess, well for starters I hope you the best hitting your first consistent 10 players then we can discuss how small this number,  you are not luckier than NetherGames who closed their doors three months now and I feel sorry for them, strange for a big server to not have such arrogance sharing their technology and keeping a part of PMMP Alive huh?

Netherrack would be easier for you,  amateur to build your first ever Minecraft network, I never had this amm easy beginning in my career but here I hand it to you in the next couple of months, it's going slow I know but take it easy.  enhance yourself abit until I finish it.

and I hope the best for you.

posts.title: Amateur ! Are you still wandering around ?
posts.body:
Oh Hey! Mr Amateur , well, I were your place, some time in July of 2020, was 11 years old , agghh it's not strange that I started programming at that age or something to admire me about, but we didn't have what you call AI, or a full developer documentation, at my time I discovered PMMP through aternos because I had the dream any kid would have , create a Minecraft server and invite all of my friends into it.

Eventually that failed but I discovered PMMP,  it was on API 3, for me it was a miracle, oooh Ranks, permissions, kits, for me its like magic.
but I did the thing most Amateurs may and may not do " why even learn php , I'm working on a game " and the first Advice is PLEASE! I BEG YOU! Learn the Language in which you will write your plugins, and don't go to the Minecraft Java Edition Ecosystem because they have Skript, you have just commited a crime , and you are not a programmer you are just a fucking configurator and the so called AI has took your so called Imaginary Job, and I won't shock you but you must conclude that no one will hire a " Skripter " and you wont build a successful server with it.

thats first, second wanna understand how the api works ? well to build a good plugin you must have a good work with the language that you are comfortable with it, and in the same time you have a good level of problem solving skills and curiosity and the bravery to ask " can you explain it please ", you may say I'm overreacting but really the valley of ego that many developers drown in makes them never move beyond their experience.

and yes, you will find sooo much arrogant developers that may help you in a toxic way, please don't listen to them , you will be better , they were at your place once.

on when you will be hired, in today's circumstances I suggest that if you seek freelancing , please seek a real field in CS or SWE [ Computer Sciences & Software Engineering. ] like ai engineering or backend or fullstack or devops, the field of PMMP Servers especially in today's circumstances after PMMP closed it's doors and its now forks or servers maintaining their own fork , it's not an easy way to find a good job, you might and you might not, well you entered late what I'm supposed to do? if we go back in time 3-4 years, it was at its top,  PMMP's API 4 has just released, many commissions for updating to API4 and after it by a year or so it was API 5 and it was the same wave.

sorry got you through the past and the present in one paragraph but lets say the final plan to being a better Minecraft Bedrock Server Developer Every day.
1- learn the language, really learn it, and if you focus on performance of the server, seek Go.
2- learn how to read the code and the API, the api is like a map, with some problem solving and understanding the api and a quiet good description of what you want, you will have the best combination to build any software even when you get out of the MC BE Hell.
3- you will face many toxic, arrogant, see that they are above every one developer shit, don't let that affect you or makes you want to be like them, it gives them a sort of "useless power " that at the slightest fall everyone will leave them.
4- its not a good place to stay , learn a real stack.
5- if there is money in that field, we the so called " experts " would have got it first, isn't it logical ?

I hope to see you good,  Amateur!
